== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34749) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds SOlson DS Rally.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 34 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 34 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>b2b1d6287236fc5dd7320b7cfe7d8e11f79598755422053fcf46c59764e1d3d1</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 3x [[Count Dooku (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>200_76^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[General Grievous (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>203_27^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Imperial Decree (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_108^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 2x [[Maul's Sith Infiltrator (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>12_183</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>2x Maul’s Sith Infiltrator (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>112_16*, 12_139*, 7_257*</nowiki>. These visual settings did not create additional historical foil publications in the article.

=== Pending preservation ===
The individual PC deck post still needs a verified preservation capture. This outstanding work is recorded under Story 386 and Bug 407. Bill authorized publication of the checked content while that capture remains outstanding; the source has not been marked fully preserved.
